svg.title: First Pearl Shoals — Fossil shell plates and pearl-glass survey shrines
svg.desc: Luminous fossil plates make broad landings around the sentinel pockets. Prism desks and fixed survey frames provide cover; a shell stair links each reflective terrace.
svg.text: Fossil shell plates and pearl-glass survey shrines
Luminous fossil plates make broad landings around the sentinel pockets. Prism desks and fixed survey frames
provide cover; a shell stair links each reflective terrace.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
Pearlglass Sentinel · proposed in [Tidekin region design](0023-tidekin-sea-region.md).
